carried_evidence_semantics: This report records the completed release-profile execution on the original subject above. The freeze adds only selected and derived HEB-161 evidence; every pre-existing tracked path, mode and byte must remain identical. It does not claim a new execution on the evidence-only descendant. Hosted PR evidence and HEB-119 cold acceptance remain separate gates.

freeze_delta.all_other_tracked_paths: unchanged bytes, modes and path population

hosted_subject_rule: Retain the frozen PR-head commit and actually executed synthetic merge commit separately. Accept the hosted checkout only if its complete tree equals the frozen candidate tree; any difference or unavailable comparison stops qualification.
empirical_limits: One fixed fixture, one CLI and one model with three release draws per case. The retained miss remains included. No broad routing reliability, provider-wire request count, independent billing verification, cold acceptance or release claim.
